fee_notes: Royalty: 6% of Gross Rooms Revenue (GRR), no minimum stated. Services Contribution (marketing): 3% of GRR. Technology Services Fee: $17.75/room/month (computed as $1,846 for 104-room standard). Additional tech fees: HotelKey PMS $4.25/room/month, IHG Revenue Services $1,500–$3,400/month, various per-booking/per-reservation charges. Travel agent commissions minimum 10% on GRR.
